events.event_name: Party in the Park: Trio Under the Triboro
events.brand: Socrates Sculpture Park × Franklin Furnace × Materials for the Arts
events.what_it_is: A waterfront performance-art festival celebrating milestone anniversaries of three Queens arts organizations, with live performance, music and public engagement.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission is free with RSVP.
events.caveats: Official organizers describe the event as free with RSVP. No organizer-selection or paid-admission requirement was found.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 12–5 PM at Socrates Sculpture Park.

events.event_name: Brooklyn Pop-Up × BWAC Red Hook Market
events.brand: Brooklyn Pop-Up × Brooklyn Waterfront Artists Coalition
events.what_it_is: A two-day Red Hook makers market with 60+ artists and artisans, including a special marketplace for BWAC artists, plus music and community programming.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the market is free; merchandise and food are for purchase.
events.caveats: Free public market; purchases from vendors cost extra. No advance admission requirement is published by the organizer.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday Sept. 19–20, noon–6 PM each day at Dikeman Hook Studio.

events.brand: Reading Rhythms × Brooklyn Bridge Park × Spotify
events.address: Pier 6 Lawn, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: An outdoor communal reading party with live music, an hour of reading, discussion and an author conversation with Josh Silver.
events.what_is_free: The event is free and open to the public; the first 300 guests are advertised to receive giveaways.
events.caveats: Current listing says the event is free and open to the public while also offering an RSVP. RSVP is therefore not treated as an established admission requirement.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20. Lawn opens 12:30 PM; programming starts at 1 PM and ends at 3 PM. Bring a blanket and book.
